Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a mutual-assisted F/S dual-anion doping strategy that overcomes S-induced lattice strain, creating a depth-dependent architecture with regulated oxygen vacancies and a stabilized interphase. Significance: it delivers high capacity retention (84.4% after 200 cycles, 88.63% after 1000 cycles), demonstrating dual-anion doping as an effective route for durable cobalt-free Li-rich cathodes.
